title: Compiled Python bytecode artifact tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc is committed and not gitignored
evidence:
diff --git a/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc b/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f807a4d
Binary files /dev/null and b/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc differ

Verified in the worktree: `git ls-files tools/__pycache__` lists the .pyc (tracked), `git check-ignore` exits 1 (not ignored), and .gitignore's new line is only "+.pp-settings.bin" — no __pycache__ rule.
detail: A build artifact (CPython 3.13 bytecode) is committed while its source tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py ships beside it; it silently goes stale when the script is edited and pollutes diffs.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached the .pyc and add a `__pycache__/` (or `*.pyc`) rule to .gitignore.
